title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for poorly controlled blood glucose.

HPI
The patient is an 86-year-old woman presenting for a follow-up visit regarding her type 2 diabetes. She reports that she has been experiencing persistent hyperglycemia recently. She continues to use insulin as her primary maintenance therapy and does not take any other oral diabetes medications. She reports some fatigue but denies any acute distress or significant changes in her baseline status.

Medication List
- Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. She appears in no acute distress. Skin is dry but intact. Vital signs are stable.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus
2. Hyperglycemia

Plan
The patient will continue her current insulin regimen. We will monitor her glucose levels more frequently over the next month and schedule a follow-up appointment to assess the effectiveness of the current insulin dosage.

Electronically signed, T. Haddad, PA-C, 05/14/2026
explanations: Diabetes documented as poorly controlled, out of control, or with hyperglycemia is coded to diabetes with hyperglycemia.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: Hyperglycemia is a complication with its own code.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
